title: Archived WARM lineage lookup
description: An isolated authenticated gateway proves that live and archived reviewer records pass the same WARM provenance check. Missing execution capacity stops the request before launch; model and effort mismatches still refuse. No reviewer or provider command runs.

warm-preflight.intent: Resolve archived WARM lineage after clearing reviewer claims, preserve mismatch refusals and the unchanged gate/archive, then overlap two rereview RPC requests at archive I/O and verify one child and one scheduled launch with execution disabled.
